free_tier.stated: Anyone can deposit data into ICPSR’s Consortium Archive at no cost, and ICPSR covers curation costs with membership fees. The deposit-options page states no byte cap and no metering.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: The deposit-options page, the Deposit Your Data page and the 'Depositing Data with ICPSR' PDF state no per-object or per-study size ceiling.

retention.stated: ICPSR is committed to long-term preservation of published studies, with redundant backups and checks against degradation; no fixed term in years is stated.
retention.notes: The Deposit Your Data page states redundant backups and format migration; it names no retention period in years.

egress.terms: Curated membership-collection data is free to users at member institutions and costs $550 per study for users at non-member institutions; data in a sponsored archive is free to all; the depositor or a funder can pay for five years of open access.

tooling: Deposit via ICPSR's submission pipeline and the openICPSR front end; DOIs via DataCite; long-term preservation with redundant backups and format migration. No S3/WebDAV surface.
chaining: unverified: no page read states a limit on the number of studies per depositor or a per-study size negotiation.
limits_note: Human curation gate before release (weeks to months), plus the read-side membership paywall. Not self-service and not usable as working storage.

extras.verified_at_basis: re-checked against the first-party page on 2026-11-19 (a verify run); evidence rows dated by the seed pass, which ended 2026-10-21, keep that date as an upper bound
extras.quota_verbatim: No published byte cap on the curated path; ICPSR states 'Anyone can deposit data into ICPSR's Consortium Archive at no cost' and covers curation from membership fees. Size is negotiated per study rather than metered.
extras.limits_verbatim: Human curation gate before release (weeks to months), plus the read-side membership paywall. Not self-service and not usable as working storage.
extras.egress_verbatim: Free to users at member institutions; fee-gated for non-members unless the depositor buys five years of open access. That asymmetry is why this ranks below openICPSR.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Unlimited studies per depositor, each negotiated for size; curation is the throttle, not quota.
extras.tooling_verbatim: Deposit via ICPSR's submission pipeline and the openICPSR front end; DOIs via DataCite; long-term preservation with redundant backups and format migration. No S3/WebDAV surface.
extras.agent_focus: Exotic and institutional surfaces: national libraries/archives, museum and heritage platforms, genomics/biobank consortia, audiovisual archives, government open-data portals, institutional repositories (DSpace/EPrints/Dataverse/Invenio) that accept EXTERNAL depositors, publishing platforms, religious/cultural bulk corpora. Priority seam: a university or national repository whose deposit door is open to anyone and whose write path is an API.
